postEditor.xCost: A post on X uses {cost, plural, one {# token} other {# tokens}} (1 without a link, 6 with one); you're charged only once it's published.
postEditor.xCostLink: A post on X uses {cost, plural, one {# token} other {# tokens}} because it has a link (1 without a link, 6 with one); you're charged only once it's published.
postEditor.locked: This post is being published right now and can't be changed.
postEditor.draftOffer: You have an unsaved draft from {date}.
postEditor.draftOfferOld: You have an unsaved draft from {date} (made on an older version of the post).

content.title: Content
content.description: The master text applies to every network; you can write different text for each one.
content.firstComment: First comment (Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn, optional)

networks.title: Networks
networks.description: Choose accounts; you can tailor the text for each one (network limits are checked when you send).
networks.empty: No networks connected. Connect them on the “Networks” page.
networks.limit: limit {max, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}
networks.storyHint: One vertical image or a video up to 60 seconds. A story lasts 24 hours and has no caption.

media.title: Media
media.description: Pick from the brand library (Unsplash, Canva, Studio templates) or upload a photo or video (MP4, MOV).
media.replaceHint: The new file goes through the same network checks as when scheduling, and the time stays the same.
media.replacePick: Choose new media from the library below or upload a file.

schedule.title: Date and time
schedule.description: Time in the brand's time zone ({timezone}). Scheduling is a separate action below.
schedule.label: Publish time

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: Approve, reject or request changes (a comment is required to reject or request changes).

targets.title: Targets
targets.assistedHint: This network is posted to by hand: copy the text, download the media, post it on the network, then mark it here.
targets.permalink: Link to the post on the network (optional)

approvalLink.title: Public link for the client
approvalLink.description: The client sees the post and decides, no account needed. The link is valid for 7 days.
approvalLink.label: Client link

aspect.noCommon: The selected networks don't share an aspect ratio. Create a separate post for the network that needs a different format.
aspect.cropNote: The crop becomes a new image in the library; the original stays untouched.

qa.passed: Autopilot: the draft passed the quality check (length, banned words, script, similarity, figures from the profile, visual).
qa.failed: Autopilot sent the draft back for changes. Fix the text, then send it for approval:

tiktok.target: This post goes to the TikTok account {name}.
tiktok.targetUser: This post goes to the TikTok account {name} (@{username}).
tiktok.maxDuration: Longest video for this account: {seconds} s.
tiktok.disabledInTiktok: turned off in the TikTok account settings
tiktok.commercialHint: the post promotes a brand, product or service
tiktok.yourBrandHint: you're promoting your own business; the post gets a “Promotional content” label
tiktok.brandedHint: a paid partnership with another brand; the post gets a “Paid partnership” label
tiktok.consent: By posting, I agree to TikTok's <music>Music Usage Confirmation</music>.
tiktok.consentBranded: By posting, I agree to TikTok's <music>Music Usage Confirmation</music> and <branded>Branded Content Policy</branded>.
tiktok.processing: TikTok processes the post after the scheduled time; it shows up on the profile within a few minutes.

problems.privacy: choose who can see the post.
problems.commercialType: with commercial content, tick “Your brand”, “Branded content” or both.
problems.brandedPrivate: branded content can't be visible only to you.
problems.consent: confirm that you agree to TikTok's music usage rules.

pinterest.noBoards: Create a board on Pinterest, then refresh the page.
pinterest.hint: Pinterest wants you to choose every pin yourself, so Autopilot doesn't publish pins. The pin description is the post text (up to 800 characters) and the link is the post link.

youtube.intro: A Short is a vertical or square video up to 3 minutes long; the post text goes into the video description.
youtube.madeForKids: Is this video made for kids?
youtube.kidsNo: No, it's not made for kids

problems.titleRequired: A YouTube video needs a title (up to 100 characters).
problems.titleTooLong: A YouTube video title can have at most 100 characters.
problems.angleBrackets: YouTube doesn't allow the characters < and > in the title or description.
problems.descriptionTooLong: A YouTube video description can be at most 5,000 bytes.
problems.madeForKids: Choose whether the video is made for kids (a required declaration for YouTube).

gbp.callHint: The button calls the phone number on the profile.
gbp.localTime: Times are the location's local time on Google Maps.

problems.ctaLink: The Google Business Profile button needs a link: enter the post link or a button URL.
problems.title: Events and offers on a Google Business Profile need a title.
problems.dates: Events and offers need a start and an end (date and time).
problems.endAfterStart: The event has to end after it starts.

postsList.title: Posts
postsList.subtitle: Brand: {brand}. Drafts, approvals, scheduling.
postsList.media: {count, plural, one {# media file} other {# media files}}

publicApproval.title: Posts for approval · {brand}
publicApproval.validUntil: The link is valid until {date}. Your decisions reach the team straight away.
publicApproval.name: Your name (optional)
publicApproval.commentPlaceholder: Comment (required to reject or request changes)

accounts.title: Networks
accounts.subtitle: Brand: {brand}. Connected accounts that Sova posts to and imports history from.

emptyNotice.meta: Facebook didn't return any Pages. Check that you're an admin of the Page and that the Instagram account is a business account linked to the Page.
emptyNotice.google_business: Google didn't return any locations. Check that you're an owner or manager of the Business Profile and that the profile is verified.
emptyNotice.youtube: This Google account has no YouTube channel. Create a channel on YouTube, then connect again.

accounts.connectAdmin: Click a network, log in there and give Sova access. You only enter your password on the network's own page; Sova never sees it.
accounts.connectMember: Networks are connected by the workspace owner or an admin.
accounts.adminNote: For the platform admin: “Coming soon” means the server has no app keys.
accounts.adminNoteMissing: For the platform admin: “Coming soon” means the server has no app keys ({list}).
accounts.adminFlagged: Turned off by a feature flag: {list}.
accounts.denied: Connecting was cancelled on the network.
accounts.pickDescription: The network returned these accounts (Pages, profiles). Tick the ones Sova may post to.
accounts.emptyAdmin: Click a network above to start.
accounts.emptyMember: The owner or an admin connects networks.
accounts.imported: {count, plural, one {# imported post} other {# imported posts}}
accounts.linkedinExpiry: The connection is valid until {date}; LinkedIn asks you to reconnect every 60 days.
accounts.historyEmpty: No imported posts yet (the import takes up to a minute after connecting).
accounts.metrics: {likes, plural, one {# like} other {# likes}}, {comments, plural, one {# comment} other {# comments}}
